children: RNS Number : 7514Z  Henderson Far East Income Limited  20 October 2026
JANUS HENDERSON FUND MANAGEMENT UK LIMITED
The Company announces that it agreed on 20 October 2026 to allot 750,000 ordinary shares at a price of 256p per share.
These shares will be issued for cash on 21 October 2026, bringing the issued share capital and total voting rights at that date to 238,029,679.
Janus Henderson Secretarial Services UK Limited
